description: 한국도로공사_버스전용차로 구간통행속도 [roads, bridges and tunnels and bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사에서 제공하는 고속도로 버스전용차로의 구간별 통행속도 정보를 조회할 수 있는 OpenAPI이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 고속도로, 버스, 통행속도, 고속도로버스, 통행흐름분석. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
